newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea's LPMO to seek 9,458T of frozen beef.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea's LPMO to seek 9,458T of frozen beef.

text.p: South Korea's Livestock Products Marketing Organization said on Friday it would hold tenders to buy 9,458 tonnes of frozen beef at 2.00 p.m. (0500 GMT) on November 8.
An LPMO official said acceptable origins were set for U.S., Canada, Ireland, Sweden, Denmark, Japan, Taiwan, New Zealand, Australia, Finland, Mexico and Netherlands.
If it passes on the tenders in whole or partially on Friday due to high prices, it will re-invite the tenders on November 13, the officials said.
Arrivals were set for Seoul, Pusan, Daegu and Naju.
Shipment was slated for December 10, 20, and 30.
